name: Golden Carpets Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Golden Carpets Ltd is in the business of carpet manufacturing[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
GCL manufactures 100% woven carpets using high-quality heat-set polypropylene yarn imported from Turkey. It is the only carpet company in India offering customized designs. The carpets are fire-retardant, moth-free, stain-proof, washable, and odorless.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -7.87% over past five years.
